## index.md — Manifesto and current profile

# Bark in the Yard

> Stuntwoodriders in motion. Artistic and autistic verbalists. All condition eclectics. Advanced sociologic researchers. Allergic to the status quo and disposable antifuck. Sometimes we think. Sometimes we don't.

**Future, power, primitive, raw.**

Bark in the Yard is an international art collective working across contemporary visual art, urban culture, critical practice and collective action. Including posters, photography, video, zines, sound-image work, participatory projects, digital culture and practices that do not yet have a settled name, increasingly crossing disciplinary boundaries and engaging technology, social issues and cultural context.

## Positioning

Exploring the perceived geometrical and emotional relationships between humans and a given subsonic content. With the emphasis on the conscious and subliminal effects upon the individual. The collective explores notions of concealment, the dichotomy between interior and exterior spaces, and the act of looking in a media-saturated environment. Its work establishes an open-ended dialogue about social and generational identity amidst shifting visual narratives of the urban environment, counterculture movements and contemporary lifestyles.

It investigates the understanding of a globally connected reality and the interpretative frameworks through which people think about, experience, evaluate and decide to act in places, spaces and communities.

- Practice: Contemporary Visual Art
- Canonical home: https://www.barkintheyard.com/
- Geography: Worldwide, with recent activity across Africa, Europe and the Indian Ocean
- Contact: gun@barkintheyard.com

## work.md — Selected commissions and brand clients

# Selected commissions and brand clients

Bark in the Yard has provided strategy, branding, visual communication and urban art curation for cultural organisations, exhibitions, festivals and boardsport companies, to name but a few.

## Selected commissions

- 2021–2023 · House of Digital Art — Port Louis, Mauritius. Strategy, branding and visual communication.
- 2018–2021 · Réunion Métis, Festival of Contemporary Creation — Saint-Paul, La Réunion. Strategy, visual communication and urban art curation.
- 2013–2017 · Porlwi, Festival of Contemporary Culture — Port Louis, Mauritius. Strategy, branding, visual communication and urban art curation.
- 2009–2012 · Run Vie, Festival of Urban Art & Music — Vienna, Austria. Branding, visual communication and urban art curation.

## Selected brand clients

Red Bull, Red Bull Music Academy, Nike, Burton Snowboards, Element Skateboards, Zoo York, Billabong, Carhartt, Montana Cans and Vice.

## curation.md — Urban art curation

# Urban art curation

Bark in the Yard has developed urban art programmes for festivals and public-space projects in Africa, Europe and the Indian Ocean region.

## Selected programme records

- [Porlwi by Light — Coryring](https://coryring.com/porlwi-by-light)
- [Jurgen Eric: “Le street art participe à la régénération de Port-Louis”](https://www.laislasocialclub.com/article/jurgen-eric-le-street-art-participe-a-la-regeneration-de-port-louis--3153), L'île Social Club, 2017. Interview with Jurgen Eric aka Gun on the Porlwi by Nature street-art programme in Port Louis.
- [Porlwi by Nature, Street Art](https://vimeo.com/250401727), official Porlwi Vimeo account, 2017. Festival-held films crediting Bark in the Yard as curators: [Chapter 1](https://vimeo.com/250401727) and [Chapter 2](https://vimeo.com/254439816).
- [Porlwi Off](https://vimeo.com/219810081), official Porlwi Vimeo account. Films for 2016–2017 Chinatown Festival mural projects, including [The Flutist](https://vimeo.com/219810081) and [The Waterfall Legend](https://vimeo.com/180554509).
- [Porlwi by People](https://vimeo.com/232426653), 2016. Five official festival chapters crediting Bark in the Yard as curators.
- [Porlwi by Nature](https://vimeo.com/988313275), 2017. Teaser and [Chapter 1](https://vimeo.com/290452891) / [Chapter 2](https://vimeo.com/290454946) records of the programme.
- [Bault about "Porlwi by Nature Festival"](https://www.instagram.com/p/BuWMHhKlT3X/)
- [Quintessenz for “Porlwi by Light Festival”](https://urbanitewebzine.org/2017/02/12/quintessenz-porlwi-light-festival-port-louis-mauritius/), Urbanite webzine, 2017.
- [Port-Louis — Seth](https://seth.fr/en/portfolio/port-louis-2/), Seth's project portfolio documenting murals from December 2016.
- [Room 712 — Tomislav Topic / Quintessenz](https://tomislav-topic.com/room712), project documentation for Porlwi by Light.
- [Explore Port-Louis through its street art](https://veranda-resorts.com/blog/culture-en/explore-port-louis-through-street-art), Veranda Resorts, 2017.
- [Réunion Métis Festival (2019–2021)](https://www.behance.net/gallery/213409853/Reunion-Metis-Festival-(2019-2021)), brand development and festival design record.
- [Réunion Métis aftermovies](https://vimeo.com/944247395) for the 2019–2021 festival programme.
- [Run Vie 2011](https://vimeo.com/988817188), official festival films documenting several Vienna programme days.
- [RUN VIE Festival preview](https://fm4v3.orf.at/stories/1663906/index.html), FM4 / ORF, 2010.

## Curated mural artists

Porlwi, 2015–2017: Gitahi Godfrey Kariuki (Kenya), Falk Land (Germany), Vincent Box (La Réunion), Joanna Lagesse (Mauritius), Daphne Doomun (Mauritius), RYMD (Mauritius), Armand Gachet (Mauritius), Brian Lamoureux (Mauritius), Resko (Mauritius), Emilie Bosquet (Mauritius), Dévid (Mauritius), Evan Sohun (Mauritius), Kicksoz (Mauritius), Milmvs (Mauritius), Chloe Ip (Mauritius), Gael Froget (Mauritius), Kid Kreol & Boogie (La Réunion), Gorg One (La Réunion), Tata Genial (La Réunion), Meo974 (La Réunion), Floe (La Réunion), Barlo (Italy), Andrea Wan (Canada), Frau Isa (Austria), Corinne Dalle-Ore (France), Seth (France), Bault (France), Wenna (China), The Ink & Clog (Singapore), Picar (Venezuela), 44Flavours (Germany) and Quintessenz (Germany).
